title: The Manifest
text: The hull is Kindred's: their pattern, their paint, worn back to the primer by centuries of sand. Bede's team cuts the bridge hatch. Inside, everything turned to dust a long time ago. The manifest plate is still on the bulkhead, stamped steel.

lines.text: "Crew manifest. I'll read it out. Commanding officer…"
"Captain, it says Marrow, I. It's stamped from a handwritten form. It's your hand."

notes: "Captain: Marrow, I." (STORY.md §16). manifest-read brings the hold-swarm out after the team.
